project.visitorDecision: For a selected Circle Tour stop, identify one useful specialist decision, the current evidence gap, and how to move to the next saved stop without losing itinerary state.
project.primaryAction: Open the chosen independent specialist's canonical URL after reading the caveat; verify actual access, schedule or weather there.

claims.subject: other
claims.limitation: A reviewed connection is an editorial decision based on the local registry, not current park access, tickets, travel time, or a measured visitor preference.

claims.subject: park-access
claims.limitation: The official NPS page provides condition information but the bridge does not ingest it, calculate a status, or establish whether a specific hike, cruise or launch is operating.

claims.subject: other
claims.limitation: The official NPS App is only a design reference for guided stop-by-stop decisions and park-specific source checks. Its proprietary UX or data is not reproduced.

decisionState.selectedIdField: model.stopId derived from explicit stop focus or saved selectedIds
decisionState.sourceOfTruth: The existing CircleTourPage.selectedIds and the applied itinerary query direction feed the pure planNextDecision helper, which consumes only the approved static Tool Network catalog.
decisionState.unavailableBehavior: The original 31-stop planner, readable HTML fallback and official road links stay available when the approved static catalog is missing; zero specialist matches remain explicitly unknown.

scenarios.input: Open page without a saved itinerary or chosen stop
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Choose a route stop to receive a specific next check; no arbitrary first stop is claimed to be the user's intended stop.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: All 31 original stops and static independent source links remain available.

scenarios.input: Select stop 11 in July with water interest
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: One Pictured Rocks question, unknown/access caveat, canonical specialist action and original-stop link.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Typical season never certifies active boat excursions, marine safety or site opening.

scenarios.input: Choose stops 15 then 18; use Next planned stop, then Previous planned stop
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: LSPP decision changes to Pukaskwa and returns to LSPP without losing trip IDs, date or category.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: The original planner's saved selection order is authoritative, including applied clockwise direction; the bridge never reverses it a second time.

scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Keep readable static guidance and actual specialist plus official highway sources next to the original 31-stop itinerary.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: No static element pretends to know current road or park conditions.

scenarios.input: Block third-party basemap tiles and browser map imports
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Standalone decision desk and original itinerary links remain usable without a map tile dependency.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: No fake map line, hiking geometry, location or drive-time is inferred.

scenarios.input: Fail or delay the approved static catalog response
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Original stop cards and static approved guide links remain usable, with a visible unavailable message.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Never reuse a stale current-status claim or invent a replacement tool.

scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Open the specialist with an explicit warning that the selected date is outside its typical listed months.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Out-of-season does not establish closure; in-season does not establish opening.

scenarios.input: Choose ship-watching at Pictured Rocks without a matching approved specialist
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: State the missing approved coverage and offer a reversible interest reset or the original stop guide.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Never substitute a different region or assert that no ships are available.

failures.no-js: Show the original stops and static specialist/source links without requiring the client catalog or controls.
failures.no-tiles: The decision desk does not depend on map tiles; keep original list and map error fallback.
failures.no-image: No new image is required to answer; text, source caveat and link remain fully readable.
failures.stale-data: If the static approved catalog cannot load or is structurally invalid, show static vetted links and preserve the original 31-stop planner.

qa.scopeNote: Actual Chromium assertions passed at 360, 390, 768, 1366 and 1440px. Tested route-step A-B-A, keyboard Enter, applied original clockwise stop sequence, explicit no-match reset, date/season, map-import failure, catalog 503 and no JavaScript. Screenshots are retained as artifacts; independent visual screenshot inspection and observed visitor outcomes are not claimed.
